statement: NVIDIA H200 shipments to China have begun under a shift to case-by-case export review, though volumes remain minimal, with about 10 approved Chinese buyers including Tencent, ByteDance and Alibaba.
why: Reopened China access restores a large addressable demand market for NVIDIA, though subject to a 25% fee and 50% volume cap.

impact.mechanism: Resumed exports reopen China demand for advanced GPUs, partially offset by the volume cap and tariff.

evidence.excerpt: There have been minimal exports of any H200s to China so far

confidence.basis: Secondary source reporting government testimony; corroboration quoted within one document.
